violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CFM ONSITE AT BEGINNING OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM ARRIVED DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE A CFM IS ONSITE DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION AND MORE STAFF RECEIVE A CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER CERTIFICATION TO PREVENT FURTHER ENFORCEMENT ACTION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: OBSERVED FOOD DEBRIS IN BOTH HANDWASHING SINKS AND SANITIZER BUCKETS IN THE BACK HANDWASHING SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. PLEASE ENSURE HANDWASHING SINKS ARE USED FOR HANDWASHING ONLY. PLEASE REVIEW PROPER HANDWASHING REQUIREMENTS WITH ALL STAFF.

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: OBSERVED PAPER TOWEL DISPENSER AT THE BACK HANDWASHING SINK NOT DISPENSING PAPER TOWELS.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC INFORMED THE EHS THAT THE DISPENSER’S BATTERIES HAD DIED; PAPER TOWELS WERE ADDED NEXT TO THE SINK FOR THE TIME BEING. PLEASE ENSURE HANDWASHING SINKS ARE ALWAYS PROPERLY SUPPLIED.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED SLICED HAM AT 44-47F, SLICED ROAST BEEF AT 45F, SLICED CHEESE AT 47F, SLICED CHEESE #2 AT 45F, AND SHREDDED LETTUCE AT 46F IN THE WALK-IN COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED OR MOVED FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS COLD HOLDING FOODS SHOULD ALWAYS BE KEPT AT 41F OR BELOW. FURTHER ENFORCEMENT ACTION MAY BE PURSUED DUE TO COLD HOLDING BEING A REPEAT VIOLATION.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Restricted Use Pesticide, Conditions of use
violations.observation: Restricted, commercial use pesticides present in the facility are applied by the operator who is not a certified pesticide applicator. OBSERVED RESIDENTIAL PEST CONTROL IN THE ESTABLISHMENT.
violations.corrective_action: Because of their toxicity, restricted use pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. PIC DISCARDED OF PEST CONTROL. PLEASE PROVIDE EHS WITH THE MOST RECENT PEST CONTROL INVOICE AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. OBSERVED NUMEROUS FRUIT FLIES IN THE BACK KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. PLEASE PROVIDE THE EHS WITH THE MOST RECENT PEST CONTROL INVOICE BY TIME OF THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE THE FACILITY RECEIVES ANOTHER TREATMENT BY THE TIME OF THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: JALAPEÑO JARS were observed reused for the storage of SPICES.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. PLEASE DISCONTINUE REUSING THESE JARS AS THEY ARE NOT NSF APPROVED AND DURABLE, AND ARE NOT MADE TO BE WASHED, RINSED, AND SANITIZED REPEATEDLY.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED THE WALK-IN COOLER AT 48F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. THE FACILITY WAS AWARE OF THE WALK-IN COOLER NOT BEING COLD ENOUGH AND HAD PLACED A WORK ORDER FOR THE COOLER. THE TECHNICIAN WAS EXPECTED TO REPAIR THE COOLER THE SAME DAY. PLEASE ENSURE TCS FOOD ITEMS ARE NOT STORED IN ANY COOLER THAT IS NOT MAINTAINED BETWEEN 34-38F. PLEASE PROVIDE THE EHS WITH A REPAIR INVOICE BY THE TIME OF THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED MEATBALLS IN SAUCE AT 112-125F AND CHICKEN NOODLE SOUP AT 116-126F IN COUTER-TOP HOT HOLDING WELLS.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC DISCARDED FOOD ITEMS AS THEY HAD BEEN IN HOT HOLDING WELL FOR MORE THAN 2 HOURS. PIC UNDERSTANDS ALL HOT HOLDING FOODS MUST BE KEPT AT 135F OR ABOVE AT ALL TIMES.
